title: Candy Portal Encounter
description: A young girl in a pink tutu and roller skates spins with arms outstretched on a swirling pink and white candy path. To her right, a blue-skinned devil with horns and a black ornate coat stands beneath a stone archway, holding a candy cane staff, while a massive glowing spiral portal of pink and white swirls dominates the psychedelic candy sky.
prompt: A young girl with pigtails wearing a pink ballet tutu and roller skates spins joyfully on a swirling pink candy path. A blue demonic figure with horns, wearing a decorated black coat, stands near a crumbling stone archway holding a candy cane staff. Massive glowing pink and white spiral portal swirls in a psychedelic sky filled with stars, nebulae, floating candies and lollipops, surreal candy landscape with rock candy mountains, vibrant fantasy scene.
